hero.subtitle: Fullstack developer with 6 years of experience building performant web applications with modern architectures.

about.title: About Me
about.bio: I moved from France to Seoul to build software for a global audience. Over 6 years I've shipped SaaS platforms, e-commerce stores, and data-driven dashboards, handling everything from database design to pixel-perfect UIs.

freelance.description: Shipped SaaS products and consumer apps end-to-end, from database schemas to responsive UIs.
freelance.details: Built Cafes in Seoul (cafe discovery with Kakao Maps + mobile app via Capacitor) and Bouldrr (climbing tracker with session analytics). Solo dev on each project: design, frontend, backend, deployment.

simform.description: Built enterprise dashboards and reusable component libraries for international B2B clients.
simform.details: Developed data-heavy React dashboards with TypeScript. Created a shared design system used across 3 client projects, cutting UI dev time significantly.

gifi.description: Worked on the e-commerce platform of France's largest home & DIY retailer (900+ stores).
gifi.details: Improved product listing performance and built internal inventory management tools. Focused on page speed and conversion-friendly UX.

mobsuccess.description: Developed real-time analytics dashboards for a mobile marketing platform.
mobsuccess.details: Built campaign reporting interfaces with live data feeds. First professional role, learned to work with large datasets and tight sprint cycles.

cafesInSeoul.description: Discover the best cafes in Seoul. Search by neighborhood, read reviews, and browse ratings. Built with Next.js, Supabase, and Kakao Maps.

bouldrr.description: Track your bouldering sessions, visualize progression, and share videos with the climbing community.

draftPredictions.description: Predict Karmine Corp draft picks during League of Legends LEC matches.

woeve.description: Agency site for a product design studio. Bilingual FR/EN, scroll-driven animations.

react.description: My primary UI library. Built complex dashboards, real-time feeds, and interactive maps with hooks, context, and custom state patterns.

nextjs.description: Go-to framework for every project. App Router, server components, API routes, ISR. Used on Cafes in Seoul, Bouldrr, and this portfolio.

typescript.description: Write everything in TS. Generics, discriminated unions, strict mode. Catches bugs before they hit production.

supabase.description: Auth, Postgres, real-time subscriptions, storage, edge functions. My default backend for shipping fast.

tailwind.description: Utility-first CSS for rapid prototyping and production. Custom design tokens, responsive layouts, dark themes.

javascript.description: 6+ years across frontend and backend. ES6+, async patterns, Node.js, browser APIs.

postgresql.description: Complex queries, migrations, row-level security, stored functions. Design schemas that scale.

vercel.description: Seamless CI/CD, preview deployments, edge functions. Deploy and forget.

git.description: Feature branches, rebasing, clean commit history. Every project, every day.

docker.description: Dev environments, compose stacks, self-hosted services. Run my own infra at home.

restapi.description: Design, build, and document APIs. Auth middleware, rate limiting, versioning.

auth.description: JWT, OAuth, session tokens, role-based access. Shipped auth flows for multiple production apps.
